role: Immutable provenance metadata schema for knowledge graph nodes and edges, enforcing CANON A.11/A.18 source tracking.
detail: Defines ProvenanceSource enum with five fixed categories (SENSOR, GUARDIAN, INFERENCE, GUARDIAN_APPROVED_INFERENCE, TAUGHT_PROCEDURE) and Provenance frozen BaseModel that records source, source_id, timestamp, and confidence (0.0-1.0 scale) for every graph entity. Provenance is immutable after creation and frozen via Pydantic ConfigDict. Each node/edge carries provenance tracing to source origin per CANON A.11. Guardian statements default to confidence 1.0; sensor observations inherit detector confidence scores. Includes _utc_now() factory returning timezone-aware UTC datetime for provenance.timestamp field. No database/network writes; purely schema definition.
